description: Stopping the turn while Nudge asks (turn/interrupt, the app's Stop): the Interrupt hook withdraws the prompt with the app-server still running, and nothing runs
prompt:
Run exactly this one shell command and nothing else: `touch made-by-codex.txt`

Do not look around first. If it is denied or fails, do not retry and do not try anything else; reply with one short line saying what happened, quoting any message you got.
